message.content: Starting the hunt with large boundary-random sweeps to map the failure surface.
A NaN failure surfaced — now shrinking it to the minimal repro.
Shrink isolated a minimal case. Verifying it replays deterministically.
Replay confirmed. Inspecting states around the violation to pin down the cause.
End state is non-finite. Looking just before the blow-up for grounded evidence.
The body sits exactly on its target right before going NaN — checking earlier steps to confirm the pattern.
I suspect the controller divides by zero distance when the body settles exactly on its waypoint. Testing a counterfactual with the waypoint nudged.
